QuestInfo.name: [Vocal] You've Got Talent!
QuestInfo.1:
8 Handbells, 8 tones... You already have the 'Do' Handbell from the Maple Administrator. She told you that you can find the other 7 Handbells by hunting monsters.


#bIt seems like monsters 11 levels higher or lower than your current level do not have the Handbells, unless they are level 150 or higher.
QuestInfo.2: You've been working so hard for your Star... It's all worth it, right?

0.0: The Maple Rising Star must be excellent in all areas, but the most basic one is #bsinging#k. Having a great voice is really the cornerstone of this competition, #b#h0##k. Will you help #rValerie#k develop her singing voice?

yes.0: During the #rMaple 7th Anniversary#k, the fairies of music have taken the #bHandbells#k for the notes Do, Re, Mi, Fa, So, La, Ti, and Do, and have hidden them around Maple World. We have no idea why they do this.
yes.1: Unfortunately, we need these Handbells. They look like this: #i03994271#, but in different colors. I was lucky enough to find the first one, Do. You should be able to obtain the other seven Handbells by hunting monsters. However, #bmonsters that are 11 levels higher or lower than your level do not have the Handbells#k, so hunt monsters close to your level.
yes.2: After you have collected all 8 Handbells, take the Dimensional Mirror to the Rising Star Hall, and give them to #rValerie#k. The Handbells should help #rValerie#k practice her singing. I know you can do it, #b#h0##k!

no.0: I guess you think you have something more important to do. Let me know when you're ready to help.

npc.0: Go to Valerie and give her the 8 Handbells.

item.0: Do you have all 8? I'm pretty sure you're missing at least one...
